content: Əngya kamngga a ǝnagha fingya fatakkwaya
A yanang na shingnda tǝ njaara wa, hwanuwun tǝ sammayirha kǝla yiwa china. Wundǝlaya kǝm, kalang kanda sǝ kǝla wan manggiwa.
Fǝrang mamnggirha suhurya nishya kǝla manggiwa, kalang wangya nishya sǝ kǝm kǝla wan manggiwa tǝ hura chahal.
Ɗang nishya mǝrya sǝ na a kaɗa thlaara tǝ ƙǝkafek.

Amma ana nu mǝrra sǝ na tǝ wanggighǝn sǝ nduwa kaghayighǝn, a takkwa samad Faara nda ˈwan, na nda a ǝna taara tǝ ǝnɗi tsahana nda. Na nda a ƙǝlang hurfayindan, na nda a ɗang chinggindan sǝ tǝ kaghayindan ƙǝla ˈwa na nda ǝnang kanda, ƙǝsǝr nǝn mbǝnang nda Faara.
Nu mǝrra na midghǝn thlaara mal nandan katenggǝn nǝn shengteena Faara fa tǝ kǝm nǝn ɗǝrha mbeeɗǝ tǝ hwan Faara nda fiɗikrha tǝ yanfaara a ɗanggǝn sǝ.
Amma nu mǝrra na tsaurha ka tǝk mbǝnda fa kee, ˈwaɗǝ teena mǝrɗǝ ko ɓal nǝn a yibrha fa ƙǝsǝr tsakh pathlanggǝn hai tǝ Faara.
Pǝrang ǝnggini fatakkwaya ya amawana kowunni tsaurha ǝnˈyaara ahu ǝngginiya.
Nafiya mbuwa ɗang hurfayindan sǝ, mbǝ kǝla ma nafiya nananda ahur minda tal wa, kaar nda ˈya fǝr nǝm ƙǝkafek atenggǝn. Tur nafini ya kal nda nafiya fǝrwawa ƙǝkafek sǝbrha ɗǝ.
Kapa nǝm thlǝɗang nda nu mǝrra ahur nishya mǝrya hai na fatakkwaya ɗang kanda sǝ, kǝl a kalɗǝ hurarha kumnggit mikki, tǝ kǝm ka nuneefa ni hu sayidɗi ɓal na chimadghǝn hai.

Tǝtani a fǝrangga fiya mamnggirha ƙǝsǝr ka ˈya ǝnanǝn na ngga. Ƙǝrang ɗǝ wanggighǝn sǝ ngga wa? Nǝn thlǝ rongya fa tǝ ǝnnarhami wa? Nǝn ǝnang taara fingya fatakkwaya kula manang nda altenggǝn wa? Nǝn ɗang nda nafiya sǝ na hu ɓillarha wa? Nǝghǝn nggungwa fa ƙǝtsar ka a ǝna ˈya nǝn na ngga wa?
Nishya mǝrya ɓalgha weerǝn, a thlǝɗang ɗun kanda ahu nishya mǝrya hai wa, ƙǝsǝr ɓanda narha ngingilǝm tǝ hǝshya ndusanggǝn hurndan ɗǝ ma Ƙǝrǝsti, tǝrgha mindan ɗǝrha chimadɗǝ.
A nggǝr nda kakhrha na Faara a tsǝtsǝl kanda, ƙǝsǝr hwasang nda ɗǝf mii ndan ˈwa nanda ǝnaarha
Mbǝ ma kee wa, na nda tsaha sǝsaukirha, na nda naarha wii hu wuraya. Mbǝ tsawud sǝsaukirha kee wa, amma har tǝ kiki farha fa tǝ kyarha hu ˈya hai mbuwa yindan, nanda thlǝk ǝngya kamngwawa.
Nanǝn kee niya ndang nishya mǝrna chimayindan ɓalgha weerǝn, a nggǝrgha nda ɗǝrha chimadɗǝ, nggǝt wundakhnaya nda, kǝla wurayindan nda ha. Tǝrgha tǝ tsanda mbǝ mbang thlǝk ˈya ɗimi aten ndan wa.
Ƙǝsǝr fingya nishya mǝrya ɓalgha weerǝn ˈwanda teena kyahar nda hai ma Faara, mbusamad Sheetan nda.
A na nuneefa sǝ tǝ fǝrƙǝkafek na hurfayighǝn sǝ mǝrna chimayindan, tǝtani a ɗanggǝn kanda sǝ, a fǝrang ɗǝ hǝr fatakkwaya wa. Tǝrgha na fatakkwaya ɗang nda nishya mǝryina sǝ mbuwana fa thlarǝndan sǝ.
Shingya na ǝna tar ndan mǝmǝl kamɗǝ a fǝrang mamnggirha nda kanda, tǝ ƙǝm teng ngganda kanda ngga, mbǝ kǝla ma nafiya na ǝna taara kaan yi pǝr laɓar Faara tǝ tsaharha ha wa.
Ƙǝsǝr ndagha ɗeleewar Faara, “Mbǝm nggǝlang mii kwel anaɗǝ a ɗǝk hwarma tǝ wiirha hai atenggǝn wa”
, tǝ kǝm, “Tǝ taara kamɗǝ teng thlǝthlǝn ndǝghǝn nda”
A kangna thlǝmaarha huhwaarha fa aten shingnda wa, kǝl ana nafiya sǝ sǝri nduwa mahan ɓagha ɓa tǝ tur huhwadɗi.
Kala shingnda ǝnagha ˈya na ɗimi ƙǝs thlǝmadghǝnun a mbed fatakkwaya heu tǝna fingya tǝrǝm Faara ngga.
A mbed Faara tǝ Ƙǝrǝsti Yeeso tǝ fathlǝngya Faara na wuwura, niyi a ƙǝs thlǝmad wa a takkwa ǝnggina na ya a wurna hasǝ wa, nduwa kar yanɗa na ya, nggǝm yi ɗa na taarha wa.
A nanna ƙǝkaryirha hu ɗǝfang nda niifa a tsauka shinggǝn aten tar Chinǝm wa. A ǝnanna ˈya na ɗimi ƙǝsǝr ka ǝnana fingya wa, amma tsawu chahal.
A sanna aama kee wa, so aam inabi ngguchit ka hatta hurwa tǝ ɓeerha farha na tǝ ǝnorha.
Ɗimiyid fingya nafiya nǝghǝn a pǝpal, tǝ kǝm ɗimiyid ndan ˈwaɗǝ mbeeɗǝ kapa na nda ngwang kumarha kanda sǝ. Amma fingya ɗimiyid ndan nǝn kyarha pǝpal ɓa a samarha.
Nǝghǝn kee kǝm tarya na ngga nanda a pǝpal, ko mba nda a pǝpal ma wa, mba nda narha ɓǝɓee wa.

footnotes.text: Ƙǝsǝr ɗǝf nda mee ƙǝtǝm mba nda nggǝr ɗǝrha chimadɗǝ wa ndǝn thlǝɗang nanda kanda ahur nishya mǝrya hai ka a ɗangga fatakkwaya kanda sǝ.
